post.description: Any link to the product page works: it is canonicalized. The users share a product and its price history, each one tracks it for themselves. A product that has no price yet gets the read of its first price queued, which `jobId` names: follow it with `GET /jobs/{jobId}`. The product goes into the group `groupId` names, else into a new group; a product the user tracks stays in its group. A user tracks a limited number of products, a group holds a limited number, and products are added at a limited rate.

post.description: The workers are given the manual proxies before the found ones, whatever their check and exit country. A proxy that is listed already becomes manual. The address may carry `user:password@` for an HTTP(S) proxy: the credentials are kept apart, given to the workers only and never listed.
